_comment: The 6-sprite picker grid: drives the REAL character-creation UI path. starts_at_title gives raw title control; creation_ui:true makes New Game open the creation screen (the default TestDriver skip goes straight to Game.reset with defaults, so every OTHER canonical is byte-unchanged). PC_OPTIONS is laid out row-major (row0 = Male across Human/Drake/Gnoll, row1 = Female) so cursor 0 starts on Human/Male; one move_right then one move_down lands on Drake/Female (same pick this canonical made pre-#42). Confirming the card sets pc_race+pc_gender TOGETHER (the payload keys the sim asserts below are byte-identical to before -- presentation-only recomposition). Asserts the snapshot identity fields, the sim variant sprite key, the GDI opener event (de-race-ified 2026-07-07 -- one opener for all races; `race` stays in the payload harmlessly, cosmetic only now), and the RENDERED variant binding on both the field (ui_entities_rendered pc_sprite) and combat is proven by the sim key (combat chip resolves the same pc_drake_f via board_renderer). Mouse teeth: after the keyboard confirm lands on NAME, an Esc-back + click-the-same-card round trip re-confirms drake_f via a mouse click, pinning the identical step:'name' payload the keyboard path just produced; the NAME step then commits via the tappable Begin control (click_char_creation_begin, issue #106) with every downstream pin held verbatim from the keyboard-commit era -- click/keyboard commit equivalence proven by the pins themselves. ISSUE #346: two setup prompts now follow the name -- difficulty (the #345 ladder) and quest hints (the #338 toggle) -- both opening on the CURRENT WISettings value and both writing those same keys, never a parallel copy. The difficulty row is answered by keyboard and the hints row by TAP (click_char_creation_choice), and a closing leg reads both back through the Settings panel in the new save's first session.

steps._comment: Cursor 0(human_m) -> col 1(drake) in the top (male) row.

2026-07-08 hotfix wave item 6: the picker grid itself had no canonical visual coverage before this (only the post-creation inn did) -- windowed-only no-op under headless (test_driver.gd's _screenshot early-returns for DisplayServer 'headless'), same established precedent as every other screenshot step in this suite.
steps.name: 00_picker_grid_drake_f_selected

steps._comment: Mouse-click round trip: Esc backs up to PICK, re-highlighting the same card just confirmed (_option_index() resolves drake/f back to cursor 4); a click on that SAME card (card_rect(4), 1-based 'card':5) re-confirms it, pinning the IDENTICAL step:'name' payload the keyboard confirm above just produced -- click-confirm dispatch parity for the exact selection a real player would have made, not a parallel activation path.
steps.name: cancel

steps._comment: Issue #106 + #346: the NAME step no longer commits -- two setup prompts follow it -- so this control now reads 'Continue' and its tap leaves NAME for the difficulty prompt. Every downstream identity pin below is still held VERBATIM from the keyboard-commit era of this script, so the click path proving them is still the equivalence proof; the commit itself moved to the last setup row.

Issue #346: the difficulty prompt OPENS ON THE CURRENT SETTING (cursor 1 = Silver, the shipped-balance default), because the Settings panel is the source of truth and this screen is a shortcut into it, not a second copy. One down reaches Gold; confirm accepts and moves on.
steps.name: 02_creation_difficulty

steps._comment: ...and the hints prompt likewise opens on the live value (cursor 0 = Yes, GH#338's default-ON). This row is committed by TAP (click_char_creation_choice, the click_char_creation_card idiom) rather than by key: a4 #216's credits modal is the standing lesson that a new keyboard-only surface strands a touch player, and this is the LAST step, so the tap both answers the prompt and starts the run.
steps.name: 03_creation_hints

steps._comment: GDI opener (2026-07-07 rewrite: one race-neutral system-readout opener, no more Drake/Human/Gnoll branch) -- lines still 4; race stays in the payload cosmetically (Game.sim.pc_race is unchanged, so this pin still holds).
Sim identity fields in the snapshot (art-independent).
The sim's variant key (presentation resolves this to the pc_drake_f sprite at both bind sites).
The RENDERED field binding: world.gd resolved the PC visual to the drake/f variant art.

== ISSUE #346's OWN GATE: the chosen values are LIVE in the first session of the new save, read back through the Settings panel itself -- the same rows that own them. Pause -> Settings, then nudge the cursor to force a fresh render (open()'s own render fires BEFORE ui_settings_shown, so it is already behind the forward-only wait cursor -- the settings_loop idiom).
steps.name: cancel
